title: A Lock-Free, Fully GPU-Resident Architecture for the Verification of Goldbach's Conjecture
summary: We present a device-resident, multi-GPU architecture for the large-scale computational verification of Goldbach's conjecture. In prior work, a segmented double-sieve eliminated monolithic VRAM bottlenecks but remained constrained by host-side sieve construction and PCIe transfer latency.
